outcome: Length of active phase of labor
Rate of transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN)
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Maternal risks during intrapartum and postpartum periods
cohort: 207 women with idiopathic polyhydramnios and 336 matched healthy pregnant patients
finding: Women with idiopathic polyhydramnios experienced longer active labor, higher risks of preterm birth and cesarean section, and their infants had a higher likelihood of neonatal morbidities and anomalies, but no significant maternal risks were observed.
mod_finding: The risk of caesarean section was higher in women with idiopathic polyhydramnios (OR 2.26; 95% CI: 1.56-3.28).
